meaning: The identification of the prima via's first mover moved by none with the quarta via's maximal being, from the genus principle (q.2 a.3), 'moves only as in act' (q.2 a.3), 'nothing has actuality except insofar as it is' (q.4 a.1 ad 3), q.105 a.5 (every created agent is applied to act by God; translation basis), the open premise STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD, and excluded middle. That the q.105 a.5 premise and the open premise are each needed is verified in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING.
